svg.aria-label: ilhop: one key hops the pointer and keyboard between a Linux machine running Hyprland and a Mac running AeroSpace, shared with input-leap. ALT+C sends the pointer to the window nearest the edge it crosses, in about 25 ms, and that window takes the keyboard; ALT+C on the Mac hops back.
